additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0421393 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
TR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Actions to Perform On-Site:
Verify Screen Issue:
Check whether the screen is completely black or if it's just a blacklight issue. If there is backlight, refer to the Q feedback below for troubleshooting.
Link:
SI E Q-Feedback Q2302 Sicharge D - HMI Backlight Off and Scrambled Image Due to R... - ID: 109816666 - Industry Support Siemens
Connection Inspection:
Verify all connections between KF1 and PH1 to ensure there are no loose connections.
Confirm the integrity of DPP and USB connections for the OC display and touchscreen functionality.
Voltage Check:
Measure the supply voltage and ensure it is delivering a stable 24V.
Cable Testing:
Swap the DPP and USB cables with known working ones to rule out cable faults.
Firmware Validation:
Ensure the D-Logic controller is updated to the latest firmware.
Electrical & Wiring Checks:
Verify if FC-12 in the automation area has tripped.
Inspect all wiring associated with the HMI and D-Logic controller for potential issues.
PCB Handling:
During updates or interventions, ensure the PCB is firmly connected. Handle the flat ribbon cable with care to avoid damage.
Site Visit Preparation:
Please ensure the spare parts HMI, DPP and USB cable are available during the visit for replacement, if necessary.
For guidance, refer to the attached HMI schematic.
If the still persists after all the verification we suggest you in replacing the control panel with generation2. Please find the below MLFB number for the same.
